note: Rules from the WGH CLAUDE.md that can be checked with a regex on added lines. A commit is 'exposed' to a rule when the anchor regex matches the CLAUDE.md in that commit's parent, i.e. the file the session saw when it started. 'compliant' matches the right way to do the same thing, so zero violations can be told apart from zero opportunities.

rules.rule: No toSorted() or other ES2023+ array methods
Use logger, never console.* directly (from Jan 25; the Jan 24 version still allowed console in catch blocks)
All localStorage access goes through src/lib/storage.js
No direct Supabase calls from components, pages or hooks
No Tailwind color classes; colors come from CSS variables
rules.anchor: Tailwind color classes|text-gray-900|Tailwind is for layout

rules.rule: Never hardcode hex colors in components (added Feb 7, reversed Mar 8)
Use .maybeSingle() for lookups that might return zero rows
rules.soft: `.single()` is correct when the row must exist, so this counts candidates, not confirmed violations.

rules.rule: ROUND() needs a ::NUMERIC cast on float expressions
rules.soft: ROUND on a NUMERIC column needs no cast, and multi-line expressions can hide the cast, so this counts candidates.
